blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Much of Luzon is forecast to experience cooler weather on Monday, Nov. 9, the state weather bureau said. According to the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical, and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa), the cooler weather is due to the expected strengthening of amihan or the northeast monsoon. READ: PH Weather Updates Today: Storm News and PAGASA Forecasts “The amihan is expected to strengthen; Northern Luzon and Central Luzon are currently being affected by it,” Pagasa weather specialist Aldczar Aurelio said.
